# WorkWise Visa

> WorkWise Visa is a premier international recruitment agency, visa consultancy, and global manpower supplier connecting skilled, semi-skilled, and blue-collar professionals with verified employers across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain, Poland, and Europe.

## Overview
WorkWise Visa specializes in ethical overseas recruitment, end-to-end Gulf (GCC) work visa stamping, GAMCA / Wafid medical guidance, Takamol Skill Verification Program (SVP) testing, Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) apostille/attestation, and real-time candidate application tracking.

## Core Services
- [International Manpower Recruitment](https://www.workwisevisa.com/): Bulk recruitment for construction, MEP, hospitality, logistics, oil & gas, and facility management sectors.
- [Work Visa Processing & Stamping](https://www.workwisevisa.com/): Visa stamping assistance for Saudi Arabia (Qiwa & MOFA), UAE (MOHRE & GDRFA), Qatar (QVC & MOI), Kuwait, and Oman.
- [Skill Testing & SVP Training](https://www.workwisevisa.com/): Technical trade testing and guidance for Takamol Skill Verification Program (SVP) for Saudi employment visas.
- [Wafid & GAMCA Medical Coordination](https://www.workwisevisa.com/): Online appointment booking and fit/unfit criteria guidelines for Gulf migration medicals.
- [Document Attestation & PCC Legalization](https://www.workwisevisa.com/): MEA Apostille, HRD degree attestation, and Embassy legalization for international work permits.

## Candidate & Employer Tools
- [Live Job Portal & Open Vacancies](https://www.workwisevisa.com/jobs): Browse active verified overseas job openings in Gulf and European destinations.
- [Track Application Status](https://www.workwisevisa.com/track-application): Real-time tracking system for candidate visa, medical, and flight deployment status.
- [UAE Work Visa & Dubai Jobs Authority Guide 2026](https://www.workwisevisa.com/countries/uae): Comprehensive 3,000+ words manual on MOHRE work permits, GDRFA entry visas, DHA medical, salary matrix across 25+ trades, and labor laws.
- [Saudi Arabia Work Visa & NEOM Jobs Authority Guide 2026](https://www.workwisevisa.com/countries/saudi-arabia): Comprehensive 3,000+ words manual on Qiwa contracts, Takamol SVP trade testing, Muqeem Iqama, Vision 2030 salaries, and labor reforms.
- [Qatar Work Visa & QVC Process Authority Guide 2026](https://www.workwisevisa.com/countries/qatar): Comprehensive 3,000+ words manual on QVC biometric testing, Ministry of Labour contracts, Medical Commission sync, North Field LNG salaries, and labor rights.
- [Gulf Countries & Visa Guides](https://www.workwisevisa.com/countries): Detailed immigration rules, labor laws, minimum wages, and living conditions for GCC destinations.
- [About WorkWise Visa](https://www.workwisevisa.com/about): Company profile, government registration, ethical recruitment compliance, and leadership.

## Technical Guides & Immigration Resources
- [Qatar Work Visa & QVC Step-by-Step Guide 2026](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/qatar-work-visa-qvc-process-guide-2026-medical-biometrics-fees-rules): Comprehensive manual for Qatar Visa Center (QVC) appointments, biometrics, Medical Commission, and Qatar ID (QID) issuance.
- [Takamol Skill Verification Program (SVP) Guide](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/takamol-skill-verification-program-saudi-arabia-svp-exam-pattern-qiwa-centers): 23 regulated professions, theory + practical exam pattern, test centers, and Qiwa platform integration.
- [PCC for Gulf & Europe Work Visas](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/pcc-police-clearance-certificate-guide-passport-seva-mea-apostille-gulf-visas): Step-by-step Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) online application, police inquiry, MEA Apostille, and Embassy legalization.
- [Wafid / GAMCA Medical Examination 2026](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/wafid-gamca-medical-examination-2026-online-appointment-rules-fit-unfit-criteria): Online appointment slip generation, fit/unfit medical conditions, repeat test rules, and validity.
- [Saudi Arabia Blue-Collar & Construction Recruitment (NEOM / Red Sea)](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/saudi-arabia-blue-collar-construction-recruitment-vision-2030-neom-work-visas): Mega project hiring guide for NEOM, Red Sea Project, Riyadh Metro, Qiwa digital contracts, and Iqama rules.
- [Kuwait Work Visa & Degree Attestation Rules](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/kuwait-work-visa-degree-attestation-rules-engineers-diploma-holders-pam-guidelines): Public Authority for Manpower (PAM) NOC requirements, KSE engineer accreditation, and degree legalization.
- [Complete UAE & Saudi Work Permits Manual](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/complete-guide-uae-saudi-arabia-blue-collar-work-permits-2026): In-depth comparison of MOHRE vs Qiwa, WPS salary compliance, and labor law regulations.
- [Dubai Hotel & Hospitality Staff Recruitment](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/dubai-hotel-hospitality-staff-recruitment-waiter-cook-housekeeping-salary-visa): Hiring and visa guide for hotel staff, waiters, chefs, housekeeping, and front office.
- [GCC Unified Grand Tours Visa](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/gcc-unified-tourist-visa-grand-tours-schengen-style-travel-gulf-countries): 6-nation unified GCC travel visa guide and online application workflow.
- [Dubai Delivery Rider Jobs & RTA License Guide](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/dubai-delivery-rider-jobs-talabat-noon-careem-bike-license-cost-salary-visa): RTA motorcycle driving license process, Talabat/Noon rider onboarding, and commission earnings.
- [Gulf Petrochemical & Oil/Gas Shutdown Jobs](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/gulf-petrochemical-refinery-shutdown-jobs-aramco-adnoc-knpc-turnaround-recruitment): Plant turnaround hiring for Aramco, ADNOC, KNPC, 6G welders, and safety officers.
- [European Blue-Collar Work Permits (Poland, Croatia, Malta)](https://www.workwisevisa.com/blogs/european-blue-collar-work-permits-poland-croatia-malta-recruitment-agency): National D-type work visa guidelines, seasonal permits, and European labor relocation.
